Table 1: Test results on WMT’14 benchmarks, in terms of TER (T↓), METEOR (M↑), and BLEU. ∆ shows difference in BLEU score against baseline 6L-6L Default. Best results are boldfaced. 60L-12L ADMIN outper- forms 6L-6L in all metrics with statistical signiﬁcance (p < 0.05).
